title: Migration 35 — Atomic status transition RPC
description: Applies migration 35, runs VERIFY A-J (object state, ACL, both happy paths, the atomicity guarantee, every authorisation branch, and the server-authoritative old_status/reviewer rules), then rolls back on a disposable PostgreSQL 18 cluster. Migration 35 owns no data, so there is no destructive-rollback guard to exercise.

verify.note: A-B are read-only object-state/ACL checks and are safe against Production. C-J are behavioural, inside one BEGIN ... ROLLBACK. E is the section that would fail if the two writes were not atomic; F, G and H are the privilege-escalation guards on a SECURITY DEFINER function.
